h1: Window cleaning in Cottages at Spillman Ridge
intro: The Cottages at Spillman Ridge is a small garden home community in Bee Cave, with 1,300 to 1,800 square foot cottages. CleanzATX cleans these windows, and the $200 minimum job is built for homes this size.

sections.h2: What the Cottages homes are like
paragraphs: These are cottages, which is exactly what makes the community different from the big estates around it. Homes run from about 1,300 to 1,800 square feet and sell in the high $400s, so they are some of the most approachable houses near Falconhead. The Cottages HOA runs the community, there is no gate, and the lots are compact, so houses sit close and yards are small. People who live here picked low maintenance, and window cleaning is one chore they like to hand off.
With a smaller footprint, there are fewer panes but proportionally more per square foot than a bigger home, because cottage plans often include extra windows for light.

Dust from nearby construction and Highway 71 settles first on front porch glass and on the sills beneath it. Cedar pollen turns a clear pane yellow in winter, and live oak pollen does it again in March and April. Sprinklers on tight lots hit the walls from a short distance, which leaves hard water spots at the bottom of the glass.

Cottage exteriors usually combine siding or stucco with stone trim. We soft wash the trim and walls with our 12V system so the stone is never pressure washed. Exterior glass is done with pure water poles and hand dried by the sun, with no soap film left on the pane.

Because the homes sit close together, we set up the water system once and move house to house when neighbors book together. That saves time without cutting corners, and we mention it when two owners on the same street text us in the same week. Interiors are hand cleaned with squeegees, and drop cloths go down at the window sill.

A 1,500 square foot cottage would come to about $150 at $0.10 per square foot, but the minimum job is $200, so the price is $200. Allow around an hour and a quarter outside. Plans like Twice a Year save 10%, and Quarterly saves 15%.

why: The $200 minimum is a fair fit for cottage size homes with 10 to 20 windows.

Tyler handles the quote, the visit and any touch up directly.

faq.q: Is it worth hiring someone for a small cottage?
faq.a: Many owners think so. The minimum job is $200, and for a house with fifteen windows or so that is a fair price for pure water cleaning that leaves no spots.

faq.q: Do you offer a discount for repeat visits?
faq.a: Yes. The Clean Windows Club takes 10% off for Twice a Year, 15% for Triannual and Quarterly, and 20% for Every 2 Months. All are optional.

faq.q: Can neighbors book on the same day?
faq.a: Yes, and it makes scheduling easier. Tell us the other address when you text and we plan the visit together.
Screens are $5, and tracks are $5. On a cottage these add little and make the windows look and slide better.

faq.q: Will you clean inside as well?
faq.a: Yes. Inside and out comes to $15 per window, and interior work is done by hand with squeegees, with drop cloths under each window.
